name: Gæludýr
tagline: Product search, shopping carts and orders at Gæludýr.is
description: Find products at Gæludýr.is, check prices and stock, and calculate cart totals with shipping costs. Sign in with Auðkenni to view your orders. Payment takes place on the shop’s website, not through the tool.
examples: Do they have grain-free cat food in stock?
Put two bags of it in my cart.
Where are the nearest Dropp pickup points?
auth: none for catalogue; phone (Auðkenni) for account

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the public catalogue by query, category and/or brand

tools.name: product
tools.description: Stock and price for a product slug

tools.name: me
tools.description: Your profile, addresses and preferred shipping (login)

tools.name: checkout_shipping
tools.description: Shipping methods and costs for the cart to a destination

tools.name: cart_add
tools.description: Add a product by ID, slug or name

tools.name: cart_remove
tools.description: Remove a product from the cart

envVars.name: GAELUDYR_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose the cart mutation tools in the MCP server

envVars.name: GAELUDYR_KK_FE
envVars.description: Session cookie value to use instead of the saved login

is.tagline: Vöruleit, vörukörfur og pantanir hjá Gæludýr.is
is.description: Finndu vörur hjá Gæludýr.is, skoðaðu verð og birgðastöðu og reiknaðu heildarverð körfu með sendingarkostnaði. Með innskráningu í gegnum Auðkenni geturðu líka skoðað pantanirnar þínar. Greiðsla fer fram á vef verslunarinnar, ekki í tólinu.
examples: Er til kornlaust kattafóður á lager?
Settu tvo poka af því í körfuna.
Hvaða afhendingarstaðir Dropp eru næst mér?
